title: MATKP Adipogenesis
dataPoints:
key,content
page_top,Explore interactive visualizations of adipogenic time series data. Within a selected dataset toggle between the three orange tabs below to answer these questions: Which transcripts have similar expression patterns over the course of adipogenic differentiation? Which transcripts change the most in expression over the course of adipogenic differentiation? How does transcript expression for my genes of interest change over the course of adipogenic differentiation. Please review our Citation Policies to ensure proper citation of the underlying resource(s). 
pattern,Which transcripts have similar expression patterns over the course of adipogenic differentiation? Find out by selecting an expression pattern icon below. Each transcript-probe combination from this adipogenic time series dataset is assigned to a pattern using the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm for evaluating similarities in temporal sequences. Data are shown in the heatmap and table for evaluated transcript-microarray probe combinations that fall within each pattern. Both the heatmap and table are paginated; use the numbers below the table to see the next page of results. By default the average of all replicates is provided at each time point and values are row-normalized; defaults can be de-selected using the checkboxes. For each row in the heatmap row-normalized expression levels are colored on a scale of dark purple (maximum) to gray (minimum). In the heatmap hover over a row to see its line plot or over a cell for more details above the line plot. In the table 'Max diff' is the difference between the highest and lowest point for any expression value for the transcript-probe combination. Click a gene name to explore on the MATKP gene page.
top_transcripts,Which transcripts change the most in expression over the course of adipogenic differentiation?  See these results in the heatmap and table below. By default the heatmap shows the top 100 transcript-microarray probe combinations that exhibit the greatest change between the highest and lowest point for any expression value over the course of adipogenic differentiation; results are ordered using hierarchical clustering. The table shows data for 10 of these 100 transcript-microarray probe combinations at a time with paginated results. Click ‘show only rows displayed in the table’ to see a smaller heatmap with results matching the table below. By default the average of all replicates is provided at each time point and values are row-normalized; defaults can be de-selected using the checkboxes. For each row in the heatmap row-normalized expression levels are colored on a scale of dark purple (maximum) to gray (minimum). In the heatmap hover over a row to see its line plot or over a cell for more details above the line plot. In the table 'Max diff' is the difference between the highest and lowest point for any expression value for the transcript-probe combination. Each row is assigned to a pattern using the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm for evaluating similarities in temporal sequences. Click a pattern name to see other transcript-probe combinations with similar temporal expression patterns. Click a gene name to explore on the MATKP gene page.
